entities.name: Minorad
entities.description: The tallest and northernmost mountain on Corondor, formerly a prominent independent city-state and center of learning.

entities.name: Library of Minorad
entities.description: The crown of the city and center of knowledge for its Sages.

entities.name: Sages of Minorad
entities.description: Scholars of Minorad who later settled Ephren on Corondor.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: Planeswalker whose teachings inspired the summit; Ravidel's master.

entities.name: Summit of Minorad
entities.description: A summit of mages and planeswalkers who swore to protect the world.

entities.name: Ash Warlord Embereck
entities.description: Summit participant who left immediately after Kristina surrendered.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Leader of the summit who surrendered to Ravidel.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Battlemage who disturbed the Summit and later destroyed Minorad in search of the moxen.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Device Ravidel threatened to use to destroy the world.

entities.name: Moxen
entities.description: Artifacts Ravidel sought to recall his master.

entities.name: Ephren
entities.description: Land on Corondor later settled by the Sages.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Period after which Minorad was a refuge.

events.summary: Inspired by Taysir's teachings, mages and planeswalkers hold a summit and swear to protect the world.
events.quote: there was a summit of mages and planeswalkers who swore to protect the world and its inhabitants

events.summary: Ravidel disturbs the Summit, threatening to destroy the world with the Golgothian Sylex if they interfere.
events.quote: The Summit was disturbed by the battlemage Ravidel , who threatened to destroy the world with the Golgothian Sylex if they interfered in his plans.

events.summary: Leader Kristina surrenders and Embereck leaves; the mages promise not to interfere and are banned from Minorad.
events.quote: As the leader Kristina surrendered, Embereck immediately left.

events.summary: 1276 years later Ravidel breaks his promise and destroys Minorad and western Corondor in search of the moxen.
events.quote: Ravidel broke his promise: he returned and destroyed the city and western Corondor in search of the moxen

events.summary: The Sages of Minorad later settle the land of Ephren on Corondor.
events.quote: The Sages of Minorad later settled the land of Ephren on Corondor .

relations.quote: the tallest and northernmost mountain on the Dominarian continent of Corondor

relations.note: His master, whom he sought to recall
relations.quote: which would help him to recall his master, Taysir
